summary: Lamar Media Corp., a wholly owned subsidiary of Lamar Advertising Company, filed an 8-K reporting an Eighth Amendment to its December 18, 2018 Receivables Financing Agreement with PNC Bank as Administrative Agent and PNC Capital Markets as Structuring Agent. The amendment extends the accounts receivable securitization program's maturity to October 1, 2029 and loosens eligibility criteria for certain receivables. No price, stake, premium, or board recommendation is involved; this is a routine credit-facility extension. Watch for covenant terms and program size in exhibits, but no deal or event-driven angle exists.
